verdict.rationale: LegalOS explicitly states that its service pricing excludes government, biometric and filing fees. It also offers a USCIS fee calculator covering filing fees, the Asylum Program Fee and Premium Processing, so government costs are clearly separated. However, it advertises fixed-fee pricing without publishing any actual service prices, so a founder cannot add up an honest all-in cost from its pages. Missing for 10: published provider fee amounts on pricing pages, a side-by-side all-in cost breakdown combining provider and USCIS fees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest

citations.quote: Pricing for services does not include any government application, biometric or filing fees.
Instantly estimate USCIS filing fees—including the Asylum Program Fee and Premium Processing—for O-1, L-1, TN, EB-1A/EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW.
